text: 商务部等7部门发布关于实施品质电商“五优”行动的通知，其中提到，加强品质电商主体培育。用好展会活动等平台，组织电商平台聚焦产品和服务质量提升公开发布承诺和行动计划，发布平台质量治理报告，主动接受社会监督，打造品质电商发展“主阵地”。发挥国家电子商务示范基地引领、辐射带动和质量科普作用，以品质为导向开展示范创建，强化信用管理和分类指导，培育一批诚信经营的品质标杆平台。
text_en: The Ministry of Commerce and six other departments issued a notice on implementing the "Five Excellences" action for quality e-commerce, which mentioned strengthening the cultivation of quality e-commerce entities. Make good use of exhibition activities and other platforms, organize e-commerce platforms to publicly release commitments and action plans focused on improving product and service quality, publish platform quality governance reports, proactively accept social supervision, and build a "main battlefield" for the development of quality e-commerce. Give play to the leading, radiating, driving, and quality science popularization role of national e-commerce demonstration bases, carry out demonstration creation with quality as the orientation, strengthen credit management and categorized guidance, and cultivate a group of quality benchmark platforms that operate with integrity.
